summary: Dining space presents minor breakable glass and potential sharp edge risks for children.

hazards.title: Accessible Glass Decanters
hazards.detail: Heavy glass liquor decanters on low console can easily shatter if pulled down.
fixSteps: Relocate breakable decanters to higher locked cabinets.
Store alcoholic liquids safely out of reach of children.

hazards.title: Fragile Tall Glassware
hazards.detail: Drinking glasses set along table edge can easily be knocked over or broken.
fixSteps: Push glassware toward the center of table when unattended.
Substitute with durable shatterproof drinkware around young children.

hazards.title: Sharp Table Edges
hazards.detail: Square dining table corners are at toddler head height and risk blunt injury.
fixSteps: Install soft corner guards on table edges.
Ensure clear walking paths around table perimeters.

hazards.title: Narrow Base Tall Pedestal Vase
hazards.detail: Tall ceramic vase placed on sideboard could tip if bumped or reached.
fixSteps: Secure base with museum putty to prevent tipping.
Move tall fragile decor away from accessible edges.

products.name: Clear Corner Protectors
products.reason: Cushions hard sharp edges of the dining table.
